## Strategy
Define
\[
A=\Lambda/I_{5,5},\quad J=\bigoplus_{333\subseteq\lambda\subseteq5^5}\mathbb Z\bar s_\lambda,
\]
\[
L_\rho=\bar s_{(333,\rho)},\qquad
R_{\rho'}=\bar s_{(3+\rho'_1,3+\rho'_2,3+\rho'_3)}.
\]
For each of the ten \(\rho\subseteq3^2\), form the complete degree-\(9+|\rho|\) Pieri matrix \(M_{9+|\rho|}\), indexed by rows \((t,\lambda)\), \(1\le t\le5\), \(333\subseteq\lambda\subseteq5^5\). Then exhibit an integral vector \(c_\rho\) satisfying
\[
c_\rho^TM_{9+|\rho|}=e_{R_{\rho'}}-(-1)^{|\rho|}e_{L_\rho}.
\]
For \(\rho=\varnothing\), this requires the explicit witness \(c_\varnothing=0\), since \(R_\varnothing=L_\varnothing=\bar s_{333}\).

## Gaps
The supplied computation artifact records complete Pieri matrices and Smith data, but no targets \(v_\rho\), no coefficient vectors \(c_\rho\), and no direct equalities \(c_\rho^TM_{9+|\rho|}=v_\rho\). Thus it does not establish membership of the ten specified differences in \(A_+J\).

In particular, the required witnesses for
\[
\bar s_{553}-\bar s_{33322}
\quad\text{and}\quad
\bar s_{555}-\bar s_{33333}
\]
are absent. The latter must have the displayed minus sign.

Therefore the requested ten-case certificate is not established.

## Next
Produce one exact task-owned witness table containing, for every listed \(\rho\), the ordered basis, target vector, complete row labels, integral \(c_\rho\), and verified equality. Each nonzero coefficient must correspond to a row \(h_t\bar s_\lambda\) with \(1\le t\le5\) and \(\bar s_\lambda\in J\).
